title: A Comparative Evaluation of Large Language Models for Persian Sentiment Analysis and Emotion Detection in Social Media Texts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the zero-shot classification performance (accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score) of Large Language Models on Persian-language sentiment and emotion datasets to address English-centric evaluation gaps in NLP.
Analyzing misclassification patterns and confusion matrices to assess how well models interpret culture-specific emotional expressions and semantic nuances native to Persian social media texts.
